title: Validity of a Courtesy-Reissued Finch Note — Finch Circle Note Accounting Clause
content:
**Clause.** For a courtesy reissue of a Finch Note in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the courtesy validity days are the courtesy day count adjusted by the courtesy returned-share method, where the courtesy day count is the tier courtesy days plus the courtesy card days, plus the courtesy registry days, plus the courtesy shopping days, less the courtesy lapse cut: under the halving method the courtesy validity days are half the courtesy day count, rounded down to whole days; under the reduction method they are the courtesy day count less 5; under the standard method they are the courtesy day count.

**Values.** The tier courtesy days are the standard courtesy note validity of the tier on the membership record. The courtesy card days, the courtesy registry days and the courtesy shopping days are 0, the courtesy lapse cut is 0, and the courtesy returned-share method is the standard method.

**Expiry.** The reissued note is valid for the courtesy validity days counting the reissue date as day 1; its expiry date is the reissue date plus those days, less one day.

The standard courtesy note validity of each tier is the figure of the reinstated and courtesy note terms.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Standard courtesy note validity of the tier on the membership record | 14 days |
| Courtesy day count | 14 plus 0, plus 0, plus 0, less 0, that is 14 |
| Method | standard: 14 |
| Reissue date | 3 March (day 1) |
| Expiry date | 16 March |

## The three methods on one day count (hypothetical day count of 31)

| Method | Courtesy validity days |
|---|---|
| Halving | 31 halved is 15.5, rounded down to 15 |
| Reduction | 31 less 5, that is 26 |
| Standard | 31 |
